rules.title: Source of lawful income discrimination ban (NJ Law Against Discrimination)
rules.requirement: A New Jersey landlord may not refuse to rent to you, or treat you differently, because of where your lawful income or rent money comes from, such as a Section 8 housing voucher. You can file a free complaint with the Division on Civil Rights within 180 days, or sue in Superior Court within two years.
rules.key_value: Source of lawful income or rent payment (e.g., Section 8 vouchers) may not be a basis for denial
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies statewide to the sale or rental of all real property, including residential rentals, except where an exemption listed below applies.
rules.exemptions: Rental of one apartment in a two-family dwelling where the owner lives in the other unit; rental of rooms in a one-family dwelling occupied by the owner or occupant as a residence; religious organization preference for persons of the same religion.
rules.citation: N.J.S.A. 10:5-1 et seq. (New Jersey Law Against Discrimination)
rules.quoted_span:
This
means, for example, that a landlord cannot deny the
lawful recipient of a Section 8 HUD voucher the right to
rent an apartment based solely on that source of lawful
income.
rules.penalty: Complaint to the NJ Division on Civil Rights within 180 days, or an action in NJ Superior Court within two years; remedies through an administrative hearing or court.

notes: The document is a Division on Civil Rights brochure (revised 06.18.15), so it may be out of date. It gives no specific statute section for the source-of-income rule. It names only the LAD and N.J.S.A. 10:5-5mm (the housing-for-older-persons definition). That's why the citation is the general LAD cite (N.J.S.A. 10:5-1 et seq.), not a specific section. Effective date is null because the document doesn't give one. The rest of the document is out of scope and was not extracted: discrimination by protected class, disability modifications, service animals, advertising, and complaint procedure. The quoted_span keeps the document's line breaks.
